manual:
The light flashes once each round, never the same colour twice
running, and then it stays dark. The dark means the flashing is
over.

Which wire to cut is named by how many times the light flashed
yellow. When the light goes dark, the flashing is over:
| yellow flashes | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| 0 | blue |
| 1 | yellow |
| 2 | green |
| 3 | blue |
